description: Broadband/Full Fibre Availability is a dataset listed in Leicester Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. Percentage of premises with Full Fibre Broadband coverage. Percentage of premises with broadband speed under 30Mbit/s. Number of all premises. Number of residential premises. Coverage: Leicester. The portal files it under City and Governance. Its keywords are Broadband, Full fibre. The portal shows 7,728 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-11-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-leicester-gov-uk-portal.
